node.title: XR deficient window: affine-plane component payment
node.statement: For a fixed residual core plane and three pairwise distinct-phi points in one selected defect block, the two block conics contain at most three target parameters without any restriction-genericity premise. On every positive-dimensional common component, a varying ray would produce three Mobius functions with three distinct poles but one affine-linear dependence; hence the ray is constant and the same-ray interaction strip caps the component. The triple incidence bound is therefore unconditional. At the next dimensions it pays every r>2ell tuple with d+ell<=6840580025 at rates 1/4,1/8 and d+ell<=3435973837 at rate 1/16; the rate-1/16 ell=1 slice extends to d+1=3523371941.
